rules.men: Centred, immediately above and parallel to the top edge of the left chest pocket.
rules.ladies_army: Bottom edge in line with bottom edge of the name tag (which sits between the 2nd and 3rd buttons).
rules.ladies_navy: Bottom edge 15 cm below the centre of the shoulder seam.
rules.ladies_rsaf: Base of medal ribbons in line with the base of the name tag.
rules.ladies_dis: Base (bottom edge) of medal ribbons in line with the base (bottom edge) of the name tag.
rules.individual_fit: Placement of medals (and name tag) may be adjusted to conform to individual figure difference.

rules.max_limit: Maximum of three SAF badges may be worn on the left chest area of the No. 3 shirt.
rules.standard_offset_cm: Centred 3 cm above the top edge of the left chest pocket.
rules.high_medal_rule: When three or more rows of medal ribbons are worn, badges sit 1 cm above the top edge of the ribbons.
rules.dis_vocation_badge_takes_precedence: For DIS, the vocation badge takes precedence over skills badges and is mounted on the top placement.
rules.no4_army_placement: No. 4: maximum of three badges on the left chest, centred directly above the top edge of the left chest pocket (SAF No.4 Dress PDF, Army Pictures C-1 to C-3).
rules.no4_navy_placement: No. 4: maximum of three SAF badges on the left chest — only two, in stacking order, when the combination includes two of PWO, CIC Sup or Submariner badges. Centred 3 cm above the top edge of the left chest pocket (SAF No.4 Dress PDF, Navy Pictures C-1 to C-3).
rules.no4_rsaf_placement: No. 4: badges are worn centred above the SINGAPORE tag on the left chest (SAF No.4 Dress PDF, RSAF Pictures C-2, C-3).
rules.no4_dis_placement: No. 4: maximum of three badges on the left chest, centred directly above the top edge of the Singapore tag (SAF No.4 Dress PDF, DIS Pictures C-4, C-5).

rules.max_limit: Maximum of two tabs may be worn on the left shoulder sleeve.
rules.first_tab_offset_cm: 1 cm below the left shoulder seam.
rules.stacking: The second tab is immediately below the first tab.
rules.alignment: Tabs aligned to the crease of the sleeve.
rules.no4_army_placement: No. 4: maximum of two tabs on the left sleeve, 1 cm below the left shoulder seam and centred to it; the second tab immediately below the first (SAF No.4 Dress PDF, Army Pictures C-5 to C-7).
rules.no4_navy_placement: No. 4: worn on the left sleeve as shown in SAF No.4 Dress PDF, Navy Picture C-5.
rules.no4_dis_placement: No. 4: maximum of two tabs on the left sleeve, worn centrally above the patch; when tabs are worn, only one sleeve badge. Keep the tabs at least 0.5 cm below the shoulder seam (SAF No.4 Dress PDF, DIS Pictures C-8, C-9).

accessories.display_name: Sleeve Badges (Marksmanship / IPPT / Sniper / Fitness Specialist)

rules.max_limit: Maximum of two badges may be worn on the left shoulder sleeve.
rules.single_badge_placement: When only one sleeve badge is worn, it sits centrally between the shoulder seam and the edge of the sleeve, aligned to the crease of the sleeve.
rules.two_badge_stack: When two sleeve badges are worn (Marksmanship/Sniper/Fitness Specialist + IPPT), the upper badge is 0.5 cm above and centred to the IPPT badge.
rules.with_chevrons: Where chevrons exist, the IPPT badge is worn centrally upon the lower portion of the chevrons.
rules.exclusivity: Only one type of Marksmanship badge may be worn. The Fitness Specialist badge supersedes all other Marksmanship badges.
rules.no4_army_placement: No. 4: maximum of two badges on the left sleeve. Marksmanship or Sniper Marksmanship 1 cm below the left shoulder seam (only one type); IPPT badge centrally 0.5 cm below it. If space is short, move them down but keep at least 1 cm below the shoulder seam (SAF No.4 Dress PDF, Army Pictures C-4 to C-7).
rules.no4_navy_placement: No. 4: worn on the left sleeve as shown in SAF No.4 Dress PDF, Navy Pictures C-4 and C-5.
rules.no4_rsaf_placement: No. 4: proficiency badges are worn centrally 5 mm below the unit patch, which sits 20 mm below the shoulder seam (SAF No.4 Dress PDF, RSAF Picture C-4).
rules.no4_dis_placement: No. 4: maximum of two badges on the left sleeve, worn centrally about 0.4 cm below the patch. Only one type of marksmanship (SAF No.4 Dress PDF, DIS Pictures C-6, C-7).

rules.placement: Foreign badges are worn according to the method of wearing of the awarding country except they are worn on the right side of the uniform.
rules.standard_offset_cm: Centred to the name tag, 3 cm above the top edge of the right chest pocket or the base of the name tag.
rules.high_medal_rule: When three or more rows of medal ribbons are worn, the base of the foreign badges is in line with the base of the SAF badges on the left.
rules.approval: Only foreign awards approved by MINDEF may be worn.
rules.no4_placement: No. 4: worn by the awarding country's method but on the right side. Maximum of three on the right chest; maximum of one tab and two badges on the right sleeve (SAF No.4 Dress PDF).
rules.no4_navy_placement: No. 4: worn by the awarding country's method but on the right side. Maximum of three on the right chest; maximum of two tabs and two badges on the right sleeve (SAF No.4 Dress PDF, Navy Pictures C-6 to C-8).
